- SDR: RTL-SDR dongles now start. Their USB transfers were twice as big as the buffers the tools prepare, so the first transfer overflowed and the radio was closed at once; samples are now handed over in pieces that fit (the same safeguard protects the Airspy and the PlutoSDR). Found thanks to the debug log of a user's RTL-SDR Blog V4
